name: word-roller-typewriter
title: Word Roller Typewriter
description: A sentence with one coloured word that is deleted letter by letter and retyped as the next word, with a block cursor that keeps blinking at the end.
useWhen: A tagline whose last word changes (amazing, stunning, powerful), in a typed, code-editor feel.
A left-aligned statement on a plain card.
avoidWhen: A single line that is only typed once: use typewriter.
A swap that should be instant or animated per letter: use a slide or wave roller.
author: lifeprompt-team

variables.label: Words
variables.description: Words in order, separated by commas. The last one is where it settles.

variables.label: Prefix
variables.description: Fixed text before the typed word.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Size of the text in pixels. A wide line shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Word color
variables.description: Color of the typed word and the cursor.

variables.label: Frames per word
variables.description: How long each word is shown, in 30 fps frames.

variables.label: Background
variables.description: Fill behind the text. Use transparent to lay the block over your own footage.
